_readme: SS-504. Indexable routes that are not expected to carry JSON-LD.
Legal and policy pages only. A privacy policy describes what the site does with data;
there is no schema.org type that says anything true about it, and inventing one
(WebPage with a made-up description) is worse than the absence.

routes.reason: Legal page. No JSON-LD, deliberately -- confirmed 2026-08-20 when its noindex was removed.
